task_reconstruction.official_task: Relate information speed to information value, filter news, and explain how opinion changes.

section_map.summary: Summary names SIIR, the RBF filter and SN-SIR with their accuracies.
SIIR system with a fixed hot-node share.
RBF filter trained by K-means and recursive least squares.
Degree-dependent SN-SIR with four separate rates.
Strengths stated as extensions of SIR, weaknesses as named omissions.

contributions.summary: A hot-node class for media, with its own contact rate.
A shared Gaussian width tied to the maximum center distance.

dependency_graph.handoff: the three-state split and the hot-node idea

assumptions.summary: No birth, death or mobility, so population stays at constant K.
The number of media is fixed inside one period.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: US circulation of five media at 1850, 1930, 1960, 1996 and 2012.
Online news dataset, 39240 articles, split 27908 train and 11332 test.

models.summary: SIR with a fixed hot-node share and two contact rates.
Radial basis filter with shared Gaussian width.

verification.summary: Facebook daily-active-user check of the SIIR trajectories.
Train and test accuracy reported separately for the filter.

results_trace.summary: More than half the Facebook users receive the message in under 7 days.
2050 reaches half coverage in under 40 days against about 50 in 2012.
Training accuracy 75.1 percent, testing accuracy 74.3 percent.
Simulation rates: Psi 0.4, alpha 0.3, Pir 0.2, Psr 0.1, on 4039 nodes.

writing_logic.summary: The introduction splits into a dilemma list and an approach list.
The disease analogy is stated before the hot node is added.
Each real-world factor is restated as a parameter it moves.

language_observations.summary: Each model is named together with the model it comes from.
Training and testing accuracy are reported as a pair.
A strength is stated as the thing the borrowed model cannot do.

visualization_observations.summary: Figures 3 to 7 plot the three shares against days for five historical years.
A ROC curve is used to argue the filter is sensitive.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: Separate train and test accuracies make the filter claim checkable.

independent_extensions.summary: Resolve whether mu infects or immunizes, and refit the trajectories.

candidate_rule_impacts.impact: Two contact rates and a four-rate degree-dependent system.
Contact probability weighted by the degree distribution.
A shared width borrowed from a stated design rule.
Five named years of circulation data, and one impossible printed count kept.
Train and test accuracy reported separately.
Each rate is varied and the direction of the effect stated.
Exclusions stated with the constant they produce.
Summary names each model and its source model.
Prose and printed system disagree on mu. Both recorded.
Each real factor is mapped to a parameter.

unresolved_questions: The prose assigns mu to recovery and 1 minus mu to infection. The printed system does the reverse. Both kept.
The Facebook daily active user count is printed as 1038 billion. Kept as printed.
The assumption says contacted infected nodes change to susceptible. The model says otherwise. Both kept.
